project_description: This project compares different numerical methods for simulating water hammer (hydraulic transient) phenomena in pipelines. It implements Method of Characteristics (MOC) as the reference solution, then compares it against Finite Volume Method (FVM), Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), and Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) approaches. Each method simulates instantaneous valve closure in a pipe with friction.
problem_domain: Hydraulic transients (water hammer) in pipelines with friction and boundary conditions

modules.purpose: Implements the Method of Characteristics reference solution for water hammer simulation

key_functions.name: simulate_instant_valve_closure
key_functions.role: Main MOC simulation with detailed physical setup
key_functions.outputs: time, H, Q, dt, a (time array, head matrix, discharge matrix, time step, wave speed)

key_functions.name: moc_solve
key_functions.role: Parameterized MOC solver returning comprehensive results dictionary
key_functions.outputs: Dictionary with time, H, Q arrays and all physical parameters

modules.purpose: Implements Finite Volume Method aligned with MOC for water hammer simulation

key_functions.name: moc_reference
key_functions.role: Retrieves MOC reference solution and metadata
key_functions.outputs: time_ref, H_ref, Q_ref, meta (reference data and parameters)

key_functions.name: exact_linear_flux
key_functions.role: Computes exact linear flux for FVM scheme
key_functions.inputs: U_left, U_right, a, c_hq, c_qh (state vectors, wave speed, coefficients)

key_functions.name: run_fvm_aligned
key_functions.role: Runs FVM simulation aligned with MOC parameters
key_functions.outputs: time_hist, H, Q, meta_out, time_ref, H_ref, Q_ref (FVM results, metadata, reference data)

modules.purpose: Implements Lattice Boltzmann Method tuned for water hammer simulation

key_functions.name: simulate_moc_reference
key_functions.role: Calls MOC reference and returns head and velocity

key_functions.name: simulate_lbm_tuned
key_functions.role: Runs tuned LBM simulation with wave-like streaming and friction

key_functions.name: apply_wave_streaming
key_functions.role: Performs wave-like streaming of LBM populations

modules.purpose: Implements Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics aligned with MOC for water hammer

key_functions.name: interpolate_shifted_characteristic
key_functions.role: SPH interpolation of shifted characteristic variables

key_functions.name: run_sph_aligned_with_moc
key_functions.role: Runs SPH simulation aligned with MOC parameters
key_functions.outputs: Dictionary with SPH results, MOC reference, and error metrics

workflow.details: moc_solve() computes reference solution with physical parameters: L=300m, Hr=70m, N=25, f=0.018, u0=0.1m/s, t_max=20s
Each method imports MOC reference, uses aligned parameters (dx, dt, a), and runs its own simulation
Calculate relative L2 error and max absolute error for valve head history compared to MOC
Save PNG plot comparing valve head history between method and MOC to png/ directory
Output wave speed, time step, error metrics, and elapsed time to console

entry_point: Multiple (each module has its own main() and can run independently)
